profit_quality.assessment: Reported FY2025 profit is not a sustainable distributable cash profit denominator after avoiding double counting of detachable financial assets. The year turned profitable mainly because listed securities generated HK$35.064 million fair value gain and HK$8.385 million dividends, while operating cash flow remained negative at HK$8.259 million.
adjustments: Excluded HK$35.064 million FVTPL fair value gain because the listed securities principal is counted in detachable cash assets.
Excluded HK$8.385 million dividend income because the listed securities principal is counted in detachable cash assets.
Excluded HK$4.268 million bank and financial institution interest income because related cash/deposit principal is counted in detachable funds.

Used FY2025 operating loss before working capital changes of HK$10.185 million and free cash flow after capex of -HK$9.527 million as evidence that ordinary operations do not provide a positive distributable cash denominator.
Floored pre-haircut distributable cash profit at HK$0 instead of using a negative denominator.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: FY2025 operating cash flow was -HK$8.259 million and purchases of PPE were HK$1.268 million; FY2024 operating cash flow was also negative at -HK$13.491 million.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: No positive cash profit denominator remains after removing returns on detachable securities/deposits and considering negative operating cash flow.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Reported profit has poor cash conversion; operating cash flow / parent net profit was about -0.25 in FY2025.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Maintenance capex is not separately disclosed; current-year PPE purchases of HK$1.268 million were used as a conservative capex reference.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Working capital changes modestly helped cash in FY2025, but cash used in operations was still negative.

limitations: Input requested 2025-12-31, while the audited annual report period is 2025-06-30; 2025-12-31 interim announcement is unaudited and was used only as a cross-check.
Cash and deposits are not fully split by holding entity or distributability, so cash haircuts are conservative.
Only two years of annual cash flow were reused from the 2025 annual report; a full three-year median would require older annual reports.
The company includes money lending and listed securities investment activities, so ordinary industrial owner-earnback formulas have limited explanatory power.
